ideas: Money removes stress up to a certain point
Relationships and purpose matter more beyond that

phrases.meaning: time spent together giving full attention

model: I'd say money makes people happier, but only up to a point. If you can't cover your basic needs, like rent and healthcare, you're constantly worried, and that leads to a lot of stress. So having financial security definitely gives you peace of mind. I noticed this myself when I got my first proper job. Being able to pay my bills without panicking made me much calmer. However, once people have enough, extra money doesn't seem to make a big difference. The excitement of buying something new tends to wear off after a few weeks, which means that people just want the next thing. Also, many people try to keep up with their friends, and as a consequence, they work longer hours and have less quality time with their families. Of course, some would argue that rich people can afford amazing experiences, and that's true. But in my view, happiness mostly comes from relationships and a sense of purpose, and money can't really buy those.
